notes.title: Symbiotic Love Demo is now available on Steam
notes.content:
Symbiotic Love, a Yuri Visual Novel that acts as a prequel to Melancholy Love, now has a demo available on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1575540/Symbiotic_Love__Yuri_Visual_Novel

Add to Wishlist above and try the demo.


 Symbiotic Love is a coming-of-age Yuri visual novel set in a southern coastal city of China. It is the prequel of Melancholy Love, another visual novel already been localized into English.
 A yuri story with mystery elements.
 Its Chinese version is rated overwhelmingly positive on Steam.
 Part of the Linghua Series (a total of four Yuri VNs).

notes.title: Melancholy Love To Be Released on the 29th January, 2021
notes.content:
Melancholy Love, a Yuri Visual Novel, is scheduled to be released on the 29th of January!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38873406/1df23c92d7312c603990c20fbfefee34ffacf413.png

Melancholy Love is a coming-of-age yuri visual novel set in a private girls' academy. It’s a romantic journey that follows an elite student born to privilege and a delinquent who wishes to break free from the chains of the academy.

Click Here To Wishlist

It will feature:


 Full Mandarin Voice Acting
 More than 20 BGMs
 10+ High resolution, stunning CGs
 and a great yuri story


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38873406/ac646fe6e0e3bbc26eb23b62216d3de7a422b91c.png

This Visual Novell is a year long effort to translate from Chinese, bringing a popular game to the English speaking world for the first time. The game will be available on both PC and MAC.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38873406/c4c9d52bacd34a8bde1d143d836bed25ba885552.png

notes.title: Melancholy Love - A Yuri Visual Novel
notes.content:
Amidst the garden of scented dreams
Elite and misfit, two extremes

One stands in spotlight, one cast in shadows
How will sparks flare as feelings grow?

As flowers bloom in the labyrinth
A lone Miss Saigon stands among the hyacinths

Like an apologetic, regretful dove
tells the story of melancholic love.

English demo is now available for download.

[previewyoutube=pt9X_H3Q3tE;full][/previewyoutube]

Melancholy Love is a coming-of-age yuri visual novel set in a private girls' academy. It's a romantic journey that follows an elite student born to privilege and a delinquent who wishes to break free from the chains of the academy.


 Game Length: 5-7 hours depending on reading speed
 Platforms: PC, Mac
 Languages: English
 Release Date: 29th January, 2021
